title: Add a machine over SSH
intro: nodeyard copies itself to another Linux machine over SSH, installs there as root (using sudo, or su with the root password) and joins it to this cluster. You'll confirm the machine's SSH fingerprint and may be asked for its passwords.
success: The machine has joined the cluster.

options.label: An additional server (needs a cluster created with HA)

steps.label: SSH login for the machine (user@address)
steps.help: The user must be able to use sudo on that machine.

steps.label: How should nodeyard become root on that machine?
steps.help: Automatic uses sudo if your user may use it there, otherwise su (you type the root password).

steps.label: Its cluster network interface (leave empty for automatic)
steps.help: e.g. eth0 or end0 on a Raspberry Pi, enp1s0 on many PCs. Automatic uses the interface that routes to this server.
